<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bar(f):
    L=f.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for r in range(64) if L[r][0]=='N')
def ring(L):
    cw=[(20,13),(20,19),(20,25),(20,31),(20,37),(20,43),(20,49),(26,49),(32,49),(38,49),(44,49),(44,43),(44,37),(44,31),(44,25),(44,19),(44,13),(38,13),(32,13),(26,13)]
    return [L[r][c] for r,c in cw]
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':32,'col':4}])
L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
print("after 1 red:", ring(L), "bar:", bar(current_frame), {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','state','game_over','level_completed','done')})
if last_action_result.get('board_changed') and not last_action_result.get('game_over'):
    for i in range(4):
        action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':32,'col':4}])
        L=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
        print("after", i+2, "red:", ring(L), "bar:", bar(current_frame), {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('board_changed','state','game_over','level_completed','done','run_complete')})
        if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('game_over') or last_action_result.get('run_complete'):
            break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
